messages.subject: plot crossovers along linkage group
parts:
Dear Karl, 

Is there a easy solution to plot crossovers along a linkage group to visualize regions with high recombiation rate and such with low recombination rate?
The x axis would probably be just the determined marker order from the map and y axis the count of recombination with in a certain bin of markers (lets say 10). 

i found your countXO function and am currently trying to modify it a bit to do the job but its not very promising looking. 
thank you, 
Michel

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] plot crossovers along linkage group
parts:
If you have a physical map, the xoi package has a function est.recrate() for estimating local recombination rate.

R/qtl also has a locateXO() function for getting estimated crossover locations.

karl
